objects.description: Plain-old-data struct carrying a 6-DoF pose/state snapshot for LiDAR/IMU preintegration. Contains timestamp offset plus arrays for acceleration, angular velocity, velocity, position, and rotation (flattened 3x3) expressed as doubles. No constructors or methods are provided; lifetime is unmanaged and trivial.

functions.name: Exp
functions.description: Computes a 3x3 rotation matrix in SO(3) from a 3x1 axis-angle rotation vector (so(3)). Uses Rodrigues' formula; for very small angles (||ang|| <= ~1e-7) returns the 3x3 identity. Intended for generating a rotation from a finite rotation vector provided as an rvalue Eigen 3-vector of type T.
requirements: ang must be a 3x1 Eigen vector of a numeric scalar type T.
ang components should be finite (not NaN/Inf).
ang is interpreted in radians; magnitude is the rotation angle; direction is the rotation axis.
No pre-normalization required; the function normalizes internally when ||ang|| > 1e-7.
For very small ||ang|| (<= 1e-7) the result is exactly the identity matrix.

functions.name: Log
functions.description: Computes the logarithm map from SO(3) to so(3): converts a 3x3 rotation matrix R into its 3x1 rotation vector (axis-angle) representation. Uses a trace-based angle extraction and a skew-symmetric part of R to form the vector; handles the small-angle case with a linear approximation.
requirements: R must be a 3x3 Eigen matrix with scalar type T.
R should be a valid rotation matrix (orthonormal with determinant near +1); behavior is only well-defined for such inputs.
Matrix elements must be finite (not NaN/Inf).
For traces very close to 3 (angle near 0), a small-angle approximation is used.
Returned vector components are in radians; its direction is the rotation axis and its norm is the rotation angle.

functions.name: RotMtoEuler
functions.description: Converts a 3x3 rotation matrix to Euler angles. Returns [x, y, z] where x=roll, y=pitch, z=yaw (radians), using the ZYX (yaw–pitch–roll) convention. Includes handling for near-singular configurations (gimbal lock) when sy = sqrt(r00^2 + r10^2) < 1e-6, setting yaw to 0 in that case.
requirements: rot must be a 3x3 Eigen matrix with scalar type T.
rot should be a valid rotation matrix (orthonormal with determinant near +1) for meaningful Euler outputs.
Matrix elements must be finite (not NaN/Inf).
Near the singularity sy < 1e-6 (pitch near ±90°), yaw is set to 0 and roll is computed from an alternative formula; callers should be aware of potential ambiguity there.
